about: I completed my B.Sc. in Energy Science and Engineering at Khulna University of Engineering & Technology (KUET) in August 2026. My undergraduate work combined experimental energy research, building simulation, modelling and project-based engineering.

My next academic goal is to deepen my expertise in power systems, smart grids and renewable energy integration. I am interested in graduate research that connects rigorous analysis with practical energy-sector challenges.
